_about: How World's ground-contact events (docs/world/ground-contact.md section 4) shape the poses (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, on_ground_event). surface: a multiplier on the bounce's crumple and pose weight by the surface class (World's proposed bounceMul: paving and rock lively, sand and rubble dead). bounce and launch: the speed (the event's vn, its spd) that gives the pose its full weight, and the least weight it gets. hold: the in and out times (s) of the brace of a tumble. getup: the wear (or brink) above which the get-up is the slow one. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.
